page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-8 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine configuration engineered for balanced computing environments. The instance provisions 8 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 31.0 GB of system memory, delivering approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. This resource ratio aligns with standard balanced deployment profiles, providing consistent dedicated processor execution without shared-core contention.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, relying instead on network-attached persistent storage volumes for operating system and application data requirements. It contains zero GPU accelerators and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which necessitates planning for external network access configurations and detached storage infrastructure.

Target workloads for the c4d-standard-8 include containerized application clusters, mid-tier web application serving, continuous integration runners, and typical business backend services that require steady compute without extreme memory density or GPU acceleration.
